title: Interactive folding panels and token-context handoff
creator: Avery Chen
summary: Design and prototype a new folding panel component that preserves token context when collapsed/expanded across the Console. The goal is a consistent affordance for dense cost and rollout widgets that need to persist selection state and show tokenized metadata without increasing surface area.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates open/collapse interaction with preserved token context for at least three panel variants (compact metrics, rollout list, cost timeline)
Token mapping doc created linking visual tokens to runtime token names and fallbacks
Accessibility review completed: keyboard navigation, focus ring, screen reader announcement for toggle state
Engineering handoff includes CSS token table, motion specs, and responsive breakpoints
design_notes: Component is a hybrid of card and accordion patterns — supports both persistent header controls and inline actions. Header shows condensed token chips when collapsed; expands to full metadata + actions.

Token context handoff: when panels collapse, we surface 1–3 high-priority tokens (e.g., model, quantization, region) as chips; chips remain interactive and open a lightweight popover instead of full panel to reduce navigation cost.
Motion: 180ms ease-out for collapse, 160ms ease-in for expand; prefer translateY + opacity rather than height animation for smoother GPU performance.
Responsive: compact variant stacks tokens horizontally on >= 600px, and switches to a stacked vertical list on narrow screens; collapsed height target 40px on compact, 56px on regular.
Cost views: collapsed state must still show current spend delta sparkline and last-24h badge so cost dashboards can be scanned quickly.
Rollouts: when a rollout card collapses, include canary status dot and rollback control as persistent micro-action to match rollout affordance patterns.
Figma components: create master variant with props: state (open/closed), density (compact/regular), tokenCount (1/2/3+), hasActions (true/false).
decisions: Use token chips in collapsed header instead of icon stack to improve discoverability — chips are tappable and more accessible.
Favor lightweight popover for token details on collapsed panels to avoid context switching into full panel.
Adopt semantic DOM structure: header button toggles panel; tokens are buttons with aria-expanded where appropriate.
Motion timings chosen to prioritize perceived snappiness over longer spring animations across many concurrent panels.
Single token tokenization mapping maintained in design system to ensure consistent naming across Console and runtime config
tradeoffs: Keeping interactive chips in collapsed state increases DOM complexity for lists with hundreds of panels — mitigated with virtualization guidance in engineering handoff.
Popover approach reduces navigation friction but may hide deeper metadata; added secondary action to open full panel for power users.
Using translateY instead of height limits auto-layout edge cases in some nested containers; engineering will implement a max-height fallback for older browsers.
review_comments: Morgan Patel (PM): Add telemetry hooks to track collapsed->expand conversions and chip clicks. Suggest capturing panel type to correlate with cost impact.
Riley Gomez (Engineering): Concern about chip interactivity inside virtualized lists — will prototype event delegation. Needs CSS token names aligned with runtime variables.
Samira Khan (Accessibility): Keyboard flow looks good; request explicit aria-live announcement for large panel content when opened to avoid missing updates for screen reader users.
Marin Alvarez (Design): Approved visual language; asked to refine token color contrast for low-vision states and add dark-mode snapshot to Figma.
Follow-up: schedule a 30-min sync with Eng to validate virtualization handoff and performance budget.
next_steps: Address Eng feedback about virtualization and update handoff package with CSS token table and event delegation notes
Refine contrast tokens and push dark-mode variants in Figma
Add telemetry spec to PRD and coordinate with Observability for tagging
Run a 2-hour implementation spike with Frontend to validate animation approach under heavy lists
Ship initial beta to 10% of Console users behind feature flag for 2 weeks and review metrics
